$comment: Generated by scripts/generate_indicator_catalog.py - do not hand-edit. Re-run it after changing indicators.py's INDICATOR_SEED or scripts/indicator_gaps.py's GAP_PLAN.

status_meaning.LIVE: Real data already populated for most companies.
status_meaning.COMPUTE: The inputs are already in the database; a compute pass over them writes the signal (no network call).
status_meaning.IMPORT: The inputs sit in files already on disk (the raw AIDA exports); mapping the columns writes the signal, no new pull.
status_meaning.RUN: A working, free adapter/crawler exists and simply hasn't been run over the company list yet (not an execution/scheduling gap, not a missing scraper).
status_meaning.GATED: Built, but deliberately blocked by a missing key, an off-by-default flag, or a policy/budget decision (e.g. LinkedIn, Kununu, Google Maps ToS).
status_meaning.NOT_ITALY: A producer exists but is Germany-only (Destatis/Arbeitsagentur/Bundesanzeiger); the Italian cohort needs an equivalent free source.
status_meaning.BUILD: No producer yet. A concrete free source exists (see status_note) but nothing extracts it today.
status_meaning.MANUAL: Tier T3 by design: collected by hand in the first-contact questionnaire after shortlisting, not automatable.
status_meaning.UNCLASSIFIED: Not yet triaged in GAP_PLAN (scripts/indicator_gaps.py) - add it there.

axis_meaning.need: Scores how much the company needs help (the problem side).
axis_meaning.readiness: Scores how ready the company is to act on a pilot (the capability side). Never blended with need.
axis_meaning.context: Not scored (weight 0). Segment tag, trend context, or a computed passthrough.

tier_meaning.T1: Structured register/API - deterministic, no interpretation needed.
tier_meaning.T2: Scrape + extract - needs a crawler and/or LLM extraction over unstructured pages.
tier_meaning.T3: Manual - first-contact interview, tier PHASE_MANUAL, not automatable by design.

indicators.label: Management Age
indicators.proxy: Average age of the executive team (CEO, CFO, COO, board)
indicators.rationale: A younger executive team tends to be less anchored to legacy habits and faster to adopt new practices.
indicators.comment: Correlation, not causation. Use jointly with New Generation of Management rather than alone.
indicators.source_description: LinkedIn executive profiles, company leadership page, Handelsregister officer records, press bios
indicators.status_note: company_people roster (age 91%): sync_management_composition_signals - only ever run when a company page is opened or on import

indicators.label: Management National Diversity
indicators.proxy: Nationality mix of the executive team and board (%)
indicators.rationale: Executives with international backgrounds are more likely to have been exposed to open-innovation practices abroad.
indicators.comment: Weak signal alone; most useful combined with International Sales Volume and Years of International Activity.
indicators.source_description: LinkedIn, company leadership page, press bios
indicators.status_note: company_people.nationality (84%)

indicators.label: Management Cultural Diversity
indicators.proxy: Cultural/educational background mix of the executive team
indicators.rationale: A management team drawing on varied cultural reference points tends to score higher on openness to unfamiliar ideas.
indicators.comment: Overlaps heavily with Management National Diversity — treat as a secondary confirmation signal to avoid double-counting.
indicators.source_description: LinkedIn, bios, education history
indicators.status_note: same; overlaps nationality (which the roster already gives)

indicators.label: Management Gender Diversity
indicators.proxy: % of women in the executive team and on the supervisory board
indicators.rationale: More gender-balanced leadership teams are associated with broader information search and less groupthink.
indicators.comment: Evidence in the literature is mixed with small effect sizes; weight lower than succession or education signals.
indicators.source_description: LinkedIn, company leadership page, Handelsregister officer listing
indicators.status_note: company_people.gender (91%)

indicators.label: Management Level of Education
indicators.proxy: Share of the executive team holding a degree or higher (Master's / MBA / PhD)
indicators.rationale: Higher formal education correlates with comfort engaging with a structured, metrics-driven pilot framework.
indicators.comment: Confidence: medium. Easy to source for executives but rarely disclosed for the wider workforce.
indicators.source_description: LinkedIn education history, university alumni announcements, press bios
indicators.status_note: LinkedIn education (reseller) or the manual Gem-prompt pipeline that already exists

indicators.label: Management Diversity of Education
indicators.proxy: Range of academic disciplines represented across the executive team
indicators.rationale: Cross-disciplinary leadership is more likely to recognize an unfamiliar external idea as relevant.
indicators.comment: Confidence: medium, best read together with Management Level of Education.
indicators.source_description: LinkedIn education history
indicators.status_note: same as mgmt_education_level

indicators.label: New Generation of Management
indicators.proxy: Years since a family-surname generational handover in management
indicators.rationale: Both a NEED signal (incoming leadership wants to establish its own track record) and a READINESS signal (a newly installed generation is usually most open to revising the business model).
indicators.comment: The strongest single trigger-event variable in this table. Pair with Management Age; treat a handover under 2 years as a priority outreach signal.
indicators.source_description: Handelsregister officer change filings, press releases announcing new CEO/MD, company 'our story' page
indicators.status_note: roster ages + appointment dates via sync_succession_signal; correctly sparse (only written when a family handover is actually detected)

indicators.label: Turnover of Management
indicators.proxy: Number of C-suite/MD changes in the past 3 years
indicators.rationale: Frequent leadership turnover often coincides with a company actively searching for a new strategic direction.
indicators.comment: Could be a liability: company needs to find its way, but might not have the time to run a pilot.
indicators.source_description: Handelsregister officer change filings, press releases
indicators.status_note: company_people appointment/resignation dates

indicators.label: Average Tenure of Senior Management
indicators.proxy: Years in current role for CEO/MD and direct reports
indicators.rationale: Very long tenure in the same senior roles correlates with entrenched routines and a higher bar for an unfamiliar external idea.
indicators.comment: Opposite reading from Management Age — keep as a separate variable rather than assuming they move together.
indicators.source_description: LinkedIn tenure history, company leadership page
indicators.status_note: company_people.appointment_date (86%)

indicators.label: Interdepartmental Collaboration
indicators.proxy: Org-chart flatness or job postings mentioning cross-functional teams (1-5 rating)
indicators.rationale: Low silo-ing correlates with faster internal alignment to launch and staff a time-boxed pilot.
indicators.comment: Genuinely hard to source externally; best captured through a short first-contact questionnaire.
indicators.source_description: First-contact questionnaire (primary data), job postings, org chart if published
indicators.status_note: first-contact questionnaire

indicators.label: Verticality in the Structure
indicators.proxy: Number of management layers between CEO and frontline staff
indicators.rationale: Flatter hierarchies shorten the pilot approval chain, reducing the 'long, complex sale' risk.
indicators.comment: Same sourcing limitation as Interdepartmental Collaboration — best confirmed at first contact.
indicators.source_description: First-contact questionnaire, org chart if published, headcount as a rough proxy
indicators.status_note: first-contact questionnaire

indicators.label: Participations in Subsidiaries
indicators.proxy: Number of registered subsidiary/shareholding interests
indicators.rationale: A simple corporate structure means less internal complexity and bureaucracy to navigate before a pilot decision.
indicators.comment: A holding structure is often for tax/succession reasons unrelated to complexity — verify at first contact before reading negatively.
indicators.source_description: Handelsregister, Bundesanzeiger consolidated financial statement notes
indicators.status_note: WAYLAND_STRUCTURE_LEGAL_OWNERSHIP export, 'Numero di partecipazioni disponibili' (622 companies have some) + the 'Partecipate' list with %

indicators.label: Independent (Non-Family) Board Members
indicators.proxy: Number of non-family supervisory or advisory board members
indicators.rationale: External governance input tends to introduce outside perspectives and lower resistance to an unfamiliar external proposal.
indicators.comment: Confirm the board member is genuinely independent rather than counting on title alone.
indicators.source_description: Handelsregister, company website governance page
indicators.status_note: company_people roles (ADV group)

indicators.label: Named Digital/Innovation Lead Role
indicators.proxy: Job title search for 'Head of Digital', 'Innovation Manager', 'Digitalisierungsbeauftragter' or similar
indicators.rationale: Maps directly to the governance question 'does an internal responsible party for the pilot exist?'. Absence strongly predicts stalling at the approval stage for lack of an internal champion.
indicators.comment: Treated as close to a gating variable: when confirmed absent, it multiplies the readiness score down rather than just contributing its own share.
indicators.source_description: Company website, LinkedIn role search
indicators.status_note: job-postings crawler - a GATE (x0.7 on readiness), so its honesty matters most

indicators.label: Depth of Internal Approval Chain
indicators.proxy: Estimated number of approval layers for new vendors/pilots
indicators.rationale: A long, multi-layer approval chain is the concrete mechanism behind the 'commitment gap: long, complex sale' pattern.
indicators.comment: Best confirmed directly at first contact rather than estimated from external data.
indicators.source_description: First-contact interview, org size/verticality as a rough proxy
indicators.status_note: first-contact questionnaire (weight 3)

indicators.label: External Collaboration
indicators.proxy: Documented past partnerships with startups, universities, accelerators, or corporate venturing programs
indicators.rationale: The strongest behavioral proof of readiness available — revealed preference, not stated intent, and it de-risks GG's pitch since the company already cleared its internal approval hurdle once before.
indicators.comment: Weight more heavily than any self-reported openness variable, since it reflects observed behavior.
indicators.source_description: Press releases, university/accelerator case studies, company 'partners' page, patent co-assignments
indicators.status_note: Google News RSS (keyless) - weight 5, readiness

indicators.label: Trade Fair / Association Participation
indicators.proxy: Exhibitor records at relevant trade fairs, membership in sector associations
indicators.rationale: Regular external engagement through trade fairs/associations indicates a company that invests time scanning the outside world for new ideas.
indicators.comment: Low-cost to check and a good early-stage filter alongside Online Market Presence.
indicators.source_description: Trade fair exhibitor directories, industry association member lists
indicators.status_note: directory-listing crawler (MECSPE only today; more directories = more plugins)

indicators.label: University / Research Institute Partnership
indicators.proxy: Named partnerships or funded research collaborations with universities or Fraunhofer-type institutes
indicators.rationale: The strongest possible precedent variable together with External Collaboration — direct proof the company has already navigated a structured external collaboration once.
indicators.comment: Effectively a specific sub-case of External Collaboration; consider merging if scoring redundancy becomes an issue.
indicators.source_description: University press releases, Fraunhofer project databases, company website
indicators.status_note: Google News RSS - weight 5, readiness

indicators.label: Prior Open-Innovation Channel Usage
indicators.proxy: Any documented sponsorship or participation in idea competitions, hackathons, or accelerator cohorts
indicators.rationale: Zero prior usage places a company at the DREAMER level at best (interested in principle, no proven execution track record); existing usage moves it toward OPERATOR/ORCHESTRATOR.
indicators.comment: A direct proxy for a company's overall maturity level — earmarked as a future primary input to that classifier rather than just one table row among many.
indicators.source_description: Accelerator cohort announcements, hackathon sponsor lists, press releases
indicators.status_note: Google News RSS - weight 4, readiness

indicators.label: Government Contributions
indicators.proxy: Public grant/subsidy hits from the EU Funding Portal search API
indicators.rationale: Recently receiving public innovation/transformation funding shows the company has already cleared a formal application and screening process — evidence of both intent and bureaucratic capacity.
indicators.comment: Reuses the existing, already-live EU Funding Portal adapter (adapters/eu_funding.py) rather than a new key — that adapter counts hits, so this stays a direct (non-inverted) count rather than the recency framing the spreadsheet describes; recency-based scoring is a real future refinement of the same adapter, not a new indicator.
indicators.source_description: Fördermitteldatenbank, EU State Aid Transparency register, press releases
indicators.status_note: EU Funding & Tenders portal (public key)

indicators.label: EBIT Trend
indicators.proxy: EBIT % change over the past 3 fiscal years
indicators.rationale: Declining operating profit is the clearest top-level financial pressure signal.
indicators.comment: A company with consistently falling EBIT may also lack budget to fund even a low-cost pilot — treat a severe multi-year decline as a distress flag, not a pure opportunity signal.
indicators.source_description: Bundesanzeiger annual filings
indicators.status_note: AIDA import (EBIT x3 years)

indicators.label: Margin Compression
indicators.proxy: Fall in gross margin as % of revenue, in percentage points (earliest vs latest year); floors at 0
indicators.rationale: Margin compression signals unresolved cost or pricing pressure that a structured pilot can target — the spreadsheet's Gross Margin row, in the original Vienna direct-compression framing that scrapers/bundesanzeiger_paid.py already produces.
indicators.comment: Compare against sector benchmarks rather than an absolute threshold — margin norms vary widely by industry. Kept as a direct 0-25 point compression level (not a signed trend). Imports convert an absolute margin amount to % of revenue first — see company_service.compute_group_value; an absolute k EUR figure must never land here.
indicators.source_description: Bundesanzeiger annual filings
indicators.status_note: AIDA import (EBITDA / gross margin)

indicators.label: Revenue Trend
indicators.proxy: Revenue % change over the past 3 fiscal years
indicators.rationale: Flat or declining top line is a direct growth-pressure signal.
indicators.comment: Check whether stagnation is company-specific or an entire-sector pattern before treating it as an internal NEED signal.
indicators.source_description: Bundesanzeiger annual filings
indicators.status_note: AIDA import (revenue x3 years)

indicators.label: Interest Coverage Ratio (Financial Pressure)
indicators.proxy: EBIT ÷ interest expense
indicators.rationale: A weakening ability to cover debt service signals financial strain.
indicators.comment: A very low ratio indicates distress severe enough to crowd out discretionary pilot budget — don't read the trend alone without checking the absolute level.
indicators.source_description: Bundesanzeiger annual filings (EBIT and interest expense lines)
indicators.status_note: AIDA import (78% - 'n.s.' where there is no interest)

indicators.label: CapEx Ratio
indicators.proxy: CapEx as % of revenue, trend over 3 years
indicators.rationale: Persistently low capital investment signals underinvestment in physical or technological capacity.
indicators.comment: Can also reflect a deliberately conservative, cash-preserving management style that may extend to reluctance in funding a pilot — verify appetite at first contact.
indicators.source_description: Bundesanzeiger annual filings
indicators.status_note: imported material + immaterial capex / revenue (77-89% of companies); take the absolute value (investments are stored as outflows)

indicators.label: Total Assets
indicators.proxy: Total assets from balance sheet (k EUR)
indicators.rationale: A medium asset base signals enough absorptive infrastructure to actually host and integrate a pilot's output — too small and there's nothing to attach the innovation to, too large and bureaucracy slows everything down.
indicators.comment: Scored as a band (sweet spot), not a straight line: too low or too high both taper the score down.
indicators.source_description: Bundesanzeiger annual filings
indicators.status_note: WAYLAND_FINANCIAL_CAPACITY export, 'TOTALE ATTIVO' x3 years (100%); the Main sheet's column is empty (0/953)

indicators.label: Cash Position
indicators.proxy: Cash and cash equivalents from balance sheet (k EUR), trend over 3 years
indicators.rationale: Low or falling cash is a warning that the company may lack the discretionary budget to fund even a low-cost pilot, regardless of how much it needs to innovate.
indicators.comment: Functions as a downgrade flag that can pull down an otherwise promising NEED-heavy profile, not an independent opportunity signal.
indicators.source_description: Bundesanzeiger annual filings
indicators.status_note: AIDA import

indicators.label: Debt Level
indicators.proxy: Total debt from balance sheet (k EUR), trend over 3 years
indicators.rationale: Rising debt signals financial strain that can motivate efficiency-seeking innovation, but high leverage often comes with covenant restrictions that lower practical readiness to commit to a pilot.
indicators.comment: Cross-check against Leverage and Interest Coverage Ratio before treating high debt as a pure opportunity signal.
indicators.source_description: Bundesanzeiger annual filings
indicators.status_note: AIDA import

indicators.label: Leverage Ratio
indicators.proxy: Financial leverage as the source defines it. AIDA's 'Rapporto di indebitamento' is total assets ÷ equity (a negative value means negative equity)
indicators.rationale: High leverage indicates financial pressure but also potential capital constraints on funding a pilot.
indicators.comment: Always interpret alongside sector-typical leverage norms — Mittelstand companies commonly run higher leverage than public peers as a matter of course.
indicators.source_description: Bundesanzeiger annual filings
indicators.status_note: AIDA import

indicators.label: Private Funding Trend
indicators.proxy: Non-bank financing raised in the past 2 years (equity injections, shareholder loans, private credit)
indicators.rationale: An actively increasing private-funding trend signals a company already comfortable raising and deploying capital outside traditional bank channels — a positive proxy for tolerance of the kind of hard-to-quantify risk a pilot represents.
indicators.comment: Banks often do not give loans for innovation because it is not easily quantifiable.
indicators.source_description: Bundesanzeiger capital increase filings, press releases on funding rounds, Handelsregister capital change filings
indicators.status_note: WAYLAND_SHAREHOLDERS_CONTROL export, 'Azionisti Tipo' (shareholder type, to detect PE / VC / financial holders) + '% Diretta/Totale' (100%); news mentions of funding rounds as a complement

indicators.label: Sector Growth Benchmark
indicators.proxy: Trailing 12-month vs. prior 12-month sector production index growth (Eurostat sts_inpr_m), matched by NACE Rev.2 section
indicators.rationale: A supporting data point for Revenue Growth vs. Sector below, not scored on its own — scoring both would double-count the same underlying comparison.
indicators.comment: Industry NACE sections (B/C/D/E) only, per adapters/eurostat_sector_growth.py's real API coverage — left not_yet_checked rather than guessed for agriculture/trade/services.
indicators.source_description: Eurostat dissemination API, sts_inpr_m dataset (keyless)
indicators.status_note: Eurostat (keyless)

indicators.label: Revenue Growth vs. Sector
indicators.proxy: Company Revenue Trend minus Sector Growth Benchmark, in percentage points
indicators.rationale: Growing slower than its own sector is a directly comparable growth-pressure signal, distinct from Revenue Trend's absolute (company-only) reading — answers Revenue Trend's own open comment about checking whether stagnation is company-specific or sector-wide.
indicators.comment: Computed in company_service.py from revenue_trend (financial import) and sector_growth_benchmark (Eurostat, industry NACE sections only) — left not_yet_checked until both are present, never estimated from one alone.
indicators.source_description: Computed: revenue_trend - sector_growth_benchmark
indicators.status_note: computed from revenue_trend + Eurostat sector growth - needs the Eurostat run first

indicators.label: Materials Cost
indicators.proxy: Materials cost as % of revenue, trend over 3 years
indicators.rationale: Rising input costs squeeze margin and motivate sourcing or process innovation.
indicators.comment: Sensitive to commodity price cycles outside the company's control — corroborate with Cost of Raw Materials.
indicators.source_description: Bundesanzeiger annual filings
indicators.status_note: WAYLAND_FINANCIAL_PL export, 'Materie prime e consumo' x3 years (100%)

indicators.label: Labour Cost
indicators.proxy: Personnel cost as % of revenue, trend over 3 years
indicators.rationale: Rising labor cost share increases the appeal of automation or productivity-focused pilots.
indicators.comment: Can simply reflect a tight regional labor market rather than a company-specific issue — check against Bundesagentur für Arbeit regional wage data.
indicators.source_description: Bundesanzeiger annual filings
indicators.status_note: WAYLAND_FINANCIAL_PL export, 'Totale costi del personale' x3 years (100%)

indicators.label: Logistics Costs
indicators.proxy: Freight/distribution cost line as % of revenue if disclosed, else industry benchmark
indicators.rationale: Rising logistics costs motivate route, warehousing, or fulfillment innovation.
indicators.comment: Rarely broken out separately in small-company filings; industry benchmark may be the only available proxy.
indicators.source_description: Bundesanzeiger notes where disclosed, industry logistics cost benchmarks
indicators.status_note: not separable: Italian statements fold freight into B7. Proxy or first-contact

indicators.label: Energy Costs
indicators.proxy: Energy cost line as % of revenue if disclosed, else sector energy-intensity benchmark
indicators.rationale: Rising energy costs are an especially strong, topical pressure point in the German Mittelstand post-2022 energy price shock.
indicators.comment: Especially relevant for energy-intensive manufacturing; less diagnostic for services businesses.
indicators.source_description: Bundesanzeiger notes, sector energy intensity benchmarks, press coverage
indicators.status_note: not reported separately in Italian statements; sector-level ISTAT/Eurostat energy intensity is the only external proxy - otherwise first-contact

indicators.label: COGS Ratio
indicators.proxy: COGS as % of revenue, trend over 3 years
indicators.rationale: A composite of the cost-pressure rows above; rising COGS share is the aggregate signal.
indicators.comment: Largely a rollup of Materials/Labour/Logistics/Energy — decide whether a scoring model needs both the components and this aggregate, or just one.
indicators.source_description: Bundesanzeiger annual filings
indicators.status_note: materials share of revenue = 1 - gross_margin / revenue, where the imported gross_margin is AIDA's 'Margine sui consumi' (an amount, 100%). NOT the imported cogs_* column: the data audit found that is total PRODUCTION costs (~ revenue - EBIT), a different ratio. Label it as a materials-based proxy

indicators.label: Service Costs
indicators.proxy: Purchased services cost line as % of revenue
indicators.rationale: Rising third-party service spend can indicate the company is already outsourcing functions it lacks in-house capability for.
indicators.comment: Distinguish from Labour Cost: rising service costs point to external outsourcing dependency, not internal headcount cost.
indicators.source_description: Bundesanzeiger annual filings
indicators.status_note: AIDA 'Costi per servizi' (B7) - NOT in the six exports on disk; needs a new AIDA pull

indicators.label: R&D Expenses (GG-Fit Gap)
indicators.proxy: R&D/development cost line if disclosed, else patent filing activity as proxy
indicators.rationale: Low or zero internal R&D spend doesn't mean the company perceives no need — it usually means there's no internal alternative to an external pilot. Less a need signal, more a fit signal for why GG rather than in-house R&D.
indicators.comment: Don't read as low ambition, read as low internal capability, which strengthens rather than weakens GG's pitch.
indicators.source_description: Bundesanzeiger filings, DPMA patent filing history as proxy
indicators.status_note: Bundesanzeiger (paid, DE). Italy: not in the six exports either (they hold 'Immobilizzazioni immateriali (Investimenti)', a coarse proxy). Options: an AIDA pull with 'costi di sviluppo', or the public Registro Imprese list of 'PMI innovative' (which must show R&D >= 3%) - verify the open-data file

indicators.label: Patent Count (GG-Fit Gap)
indicators.proxy: Patent filing count and recency, from DPMA or EPO Espacenet
indicators.rationale: Same logic as R&D Expenses: limited patent activity signals the company hasn't pursued the traditional in-house innovation route, making an external, pilot-based model more relevant.
indicators.comment: Absence of patents is normal and uninformative in many services/trade sectors — weight down outside manufacturing/technical sectors.
indicators.source_description: DPMA register, EPO Espacenet
indicators.status_note: EPO OPS (key configured, verified live)

indicators.label: Patent IPC Class Diversity
indicators.proxy: Distinct IPC classification prefixes across filed patents
indicators.rationale: Supplementary enrichment from the existing EPO adapter, not part of the imported spreadsheet — kept informational rather than scored to avoid double-counting alongside Patent Count.
indicators.comment: Displayed on the company profile but excluded from the weighted score.
indicators.source_description: EPO OPS classification data
indicators.status_note: EPO OPS (same call)

indicators.label: Trademarks
indicators.proxy: Number of new trademark filings in the past 2-3 years
indicators.rationale: Active trademark filing suggests the company is bringing new products, sub-brands, or services to market right now — present-tense openness rather than stated intent.
indicators.comment: A useful complement to the low-patent signal: together they suggest a company innovating at the brand/go-to-market level but not the technical level, exactly where GG-brokered pilots add the most value.
indicators.source_description: DPMA trademark register
indicators.status_note: EUIPO (key configured)

indicators.label: Product Demand Elasticity
indicators.proxy: 1-5 elasticity rating inferred from category (staple vs. discretionary good)
indicators.rationale: Companies with elastic demand have a stronger built-in incentive to keep customers happy, translating into higher motivation to adopt a pilot that improves customer experience.
indicators.comment: A motivation proxy, not a capability one — still requires the other readiness variables to be present.
indicators.source_description: Industry classification/category norms, review-aggregator sentiment, press coverage of pricing behavior
indicators.status_note: first-contact questionnaire

indicators.label: Product Differentiation
indicators.proxy: Number of comparable competing products at similar price points
indicators.rationale: A commoditized, undifferentiated product is under constant margin pressure and has the clearest need for an innovation-driven differentiation strategy.
indicators.comment: Best assessed together with Innovativeness of Product and Quality of Product rather than in isolation.
indicators.source_description: Marketplace/competitor listings, industry trade reports, product catalogs
indicators.status_note: the catalog's own proxy is 'number of comparable competing products at similar price points' - not something a company's own website can honestly state. Counting differentiation claims (certifications, 'only manufacturer of...') would invert the definition (a company that doesn't self-promote reads as MORE commoditized) - deliberately not built as a website-LLM field for that reason, same posture as the declined regulatory_compliance_exposure inference

indicators.label: Product Portfolio Diversity
indicators.proxy: Number of distinct product lines or SKUs disclosed
indicators.rationale: A narrow product portfolio concentrates revenue risk in a small number of lines, strengthening the case for innovation-driven diversification.
indicators.comment: A very narrow portfolio in a stable niche B2B category is not automatically a red flag — check whether the niche itself is shrinking first.
indicators.source_description: Company catalog/website, industry association member directories
indicators.status_note: company-website crawler (noisy: counts vary run to run)

indicators.label: Rarity of Raw Materials
indicators.proxy: Number of alternative suppliers available for the primary input
indicators.rationale: Dependence on a scarce input is a direct supply-risk pressure point that process or material-substitution innovation can address.
indicators.comment: Applies mainly to manufacturing and materials-intensive sectors; not applicable for services businesses.
indicators.source_description: Industry/commodity reports, annual report risk disclosures, procurement trade press
indicators.status_note: first-contact questionnaire

indicators.label: Cost of Raw Materials
indicators.proxy: Input cost as % of COGS
indicators.rationale: Elevated material costs squeeze margin directly and create urgency for efficiency or substitution innovation.
indicators.comment: Same sector-benchmark caveat as Materials Cost.
indicators.source_description: Bundesanzeiger annual filings, industry cost benchmark reports
indicators.status_note: same 'Materie prime e consumo' line (the catalog splits materials from raw materials; one source feeds both)

indicators.label: Innovativeness of Product
indicators.proxy: Years since last meaningful product update
indicators.rationale: A product line that hasn't meaningfully changed in years is the textbook target for an innovation pilot.
indicators.comment: Best corroborated with Product Age and Patents — a single missing update is not conclusive on its own.
indicators.source_description: Product catalogs (historical versions via Wayback Machine), press releases, trade fair exhibitor archives
indicators.status_note: company-website crawler's last_product_update_signal (2026-09-22): most recent dated product/press update across all crawled pages, was already extracted, wasn't wired up

indicators.label: Quality of Product (Review Trend)
indicators.proxy: Review sentiment trend (rating points change) over the trailing 12 months
indicators.rationale: A declining quality trend visible in customer reviews is a direct, externally verifiable pain point a pilot could target.
indicators.comment: If review volume is too low to be reliable (typical for B2B manufacturers), fall back on warranty claim rates or complaint data gathered at first contact.
indicators.source_description: Google Reviews, Trustpilot, industry review platforms, first-contact interview for B2B
indicators.status_note: Google Maps reviews - off by policy (Maps ToS). No free compliant source

indicators.label: Product Age
indicators.proxy: Years since the original core product line launched
indicators.rationale: An old core product line still generating the bulk of revenue is an obsolescence risk and a clear need signal.
indicators.comment: Overlaps with Innovativeness of Product; consider merging the two if scoring redundancy becomes an issue.
indicators.source_description: Company 'our history' page, trade press archives
indicators.status_note: company-website crawler's product_launch_year field (2026-09-22): only set when a page states a launch year distinct from the founding year, so real coverage will be low but honest

indicators.label: Volume of Online Sales
indicators.proxy: Estimated e-commerce revenue share (%)
indicators.rationale: Low online sales volume relative to industry peers is a direct, quantifiable innovation gap.
indicators.comment: Hard to estimate precisely without direct disclosure; treat any traffic-tool-derived figure as directional.
indicators.source_description: Similarweb/website traffic estimate, annual report management commentary, industry benchmarks
indicators.status_note: presence of a shop is known (digital-maturity); the VOLUME is not published - first-contact

indicators.label: Online Market Presence
indicators.proxy: 0-5 composite rating of e-commerce presence, social activity, and SEO visibility
indicators.rationale: An underdeveloped online presence is one of the most visible, easily verified NEED signals available before any direct contact.
indicators.comment: Fastest variable to check pre-contact — a good early-stage filter before investing research time in harder financial variables.
indicators.source_description: Company website audit, BuiltWith/Wayback Machine, social media presence check
indicators.status_note: digital-maturity crawler (e-commerce + socials + archive activity)

indicators.label: Physical Store Count Trend
indicators.proxy: % change in store count over the past 3 years
indicators.rationale: A shrinking physical footprint without a compensating digital channel signals an unaddressed transition problem.
indicators.comment: If the company is pure B2B with no retail footprint, treat as null rather than 'zero = need'.
indicators.source_description: Company website store locator, press releases, historical Google Maps listings
indicators.status_note: company-website crawler - needs a SECOND crawl 30+ days later (a trend, not a snapshot)

indicators.label: Geographic Distribution of Stores
indicators.proxy: Number of distinct regions/postal areas served
indicators.rationale: A geographically concentrated footprint with no digital expansion represents unrealized growth GG could help unlock.
indicators.comment: Same B2B applicability caveat as Physical Store Count Trend.
indicators.source_description: Company website, Handelsregister branch (Zweigniederlassung) filings
indicators.status_note: company-website crawler (most B2B machinery makers have no stores: honest not_applicable)

indicators.label: International Sales Volume
indicators.proxy: Export revenue share (%), from annual report segment notes or Chamber of Commerce data
indicators.rationale: Stagnant international sales despite an otherwise viable product is a classic unrealized-opportunity signal, and a strong one specifically for GG's German-Italian bridge extension.
indicators.comment: Where segment notes aren't disclosed, a rough proxy is whether the company website exists in more than one language.
indicators.source_description: Annual report segment notes, IHK export statistics, Germany Trade & Invest data
indicators.status_note: company-website crawler's export_share_pct field (2026-09-22): only set when a page states an explicit percentage ('esportiamo il 70%')

indicators.label: Years of International Activity
indicators.proxy: Years since first recorded export activity or foreign branch registration
indicators.rationale: Limited international experience means the company likely lacks internal playbooks for cross-border expansion — a NEED signal, but also a readiness caveat on execution capacity.
indicators.comment: Treat as a NEED signal on the product/market axis; don't double-count as purely positive.
indicators.source_description: Handelsregister foreign branch filings, company 'our history' page, trade press
indicators.status_note: company-website crawler's export_since_year field (2026-09-22): only set when a page states an explicit year ('esportiamo dal 1998')

indicators.label: Digital Maturity of Core Website
indicators.proxy: Years since last major website redesign; CMS platform and mobile responsiveness
indicators.rationale: An outdated, non-responsive website is one of the cheapest, most externally verifiable proxies for broader digital neglect.
indicators.comment: Wayback Machine coverage can be patchy for smaller company sites — treat 'no snapshot found' as inconclusive, not evidence of an old site.
indicators.source_description: BuiltWith, Wayback Machine snapshot comparison, direct site visit
indicators.status_note: digital-maturity crawler (Wayback structural diff) - timed out on 89% of runs; now still returns the homepage fields when Wayback is down

indicators.label: LinkedIn Company Page Activity
indicators.proxy: Posting frequency (posts/month) over the past 12 months
indicators.rationale: Minimal external digital communication activity signals a broader gap in market-facing digital practice.
indicators.comment: Weight lower than the balance-sheet-based NEED signals, since it reflects marketing habits more than core operations.
indicators.source_description: LinkedIn company page
indicators.status_note: LinkedIn crawler is off by policy ('highest-risk scrape target')

indicators.label: Digital/Technical Job Postings
indicators.proxy: Count of open roles mentioning digital, data, automation, or innovation in the title/description, past 12 months
indicators.rationale: Actively hiring for digital or innovation-adjacent roles is a strong forward-looking signal of building internal capacity to absorb pilot outcomes.
indicators.comment: Distinguish genuine digital/innovation hires from generic IT-support postings — only the former counts as a strong readiness signal.
indicators.source_description: Stepstone, Indeed, company careers page
indicators.status_note: job-postings crawler (careers page)

indicators.label: ERP / Core Systems Age
indicators.proxy: Years since last major ERP upgrade, inferred from job postings mentioning ERP version
indicators.rationale: Old, unintegrated core systems constrain data availability for scoring future pilots too — doubles as an opportunity signal and a data-quality warning for the pipeline itself.
indicators.comment: Directly relevant to confirming Midcap data-collection capability before a pilot starts — a legacy ERP flags the need to scope data readiness explicitly at the Diagnosi stage.
indicators.source_description: Job postings mentioning ERP platform/version, first-contact interview
indicators.status_note: keyword scan of job-ad TEXT for ERP vendors (SAP, Navision, AS/400, Zucchetti, TeamSystem...) - the crawler only keeps titles today

indicators.label: Supply Chain Digitization
indicators.proxy: 0-5 rating of EDI / real-time tracking / supplier portal technology presence
indicators.rationale: Manual, paper-based supply chain processes are a concrete operational pain point directly addressable by a logistics or process-innovation pilot.
indicators.comment: Often only confirmable at first contact for smaller companies with no public supply-chain disclosure.
indicators.source_description: Job postings, first-contact interview, sector benchmark reports
indicators.status_note: first-contact questionnaire

indicators.label: Press Mentions of New Launches
indicators.proxy: Count of launch-related news mentions in the trailing 24 months
indicators.rationale: Absence of any recent launch coverage is a simple, externally verifiable proxy for innovation output stagnation.
indicators.comment: Cross-check against Trademarks and R&D Expenses before concluding stagnation — a company can innovate quietly without press coverage.
indicators.source_description: News search (Google News), trade press archives
indicators.status_note: Google News RSS

indicators.label: Sector Export Pressure (Macro)
indicators.proxy: Sector-level (NACE code) export value / turnover, from Eurostat ext_tec01 (trade) and sbs_ovw_act (structural business statistics)
indicators.rationale: Macro, sector-wide export pressure — distinct from the company-level International Sales Volume row above.
indicators.comment: From the original sourcing plan, not the new spreadsheet; kept as its own indicator since it measures something company-level data doesn't. Originally sourced from Destatis (Germany-only, and its GENESIS table was never a clean NACE match); Eurostat covers both countries keylessly.
indicators.source_description: Eurostat ext_tec01 (international trade in goods by NACE) + sbs_ovw_act (structural business statistics, net turnover)
indicators.status_note: Eurostat export exposure adapter (2026-09-22): ext_tec01 (trade by NACE) over sbs_ovw_act (turnover by NACE), both keyless, EU-wide - replaced the Germany-only Destatis producer this indicator's catalog row used to name; ISTAT's own Coeweb was checked and found retired 2025-09-30

indicators.label: Digital Intensity Index (Tech Signatures)
indicators.proxy: Count of modern web technology signatures detected on the company's own site
indicators.rationale: Related to, but distinct from, Digital Maturity of Core Website — this measures which technologies are present, not redesign recency.
indicators.comment: From the original sourcing plan; kept separate from website_digital_maturity to avoid conflating what each adapter actually measures.
indicators.source_description: Local Wappalyzer-style signature scan
indicators.status_note: Wappalyzer-style local fingerprinting of the homepage

indicators.label: Employee Turnover
indicators.proxy: Staff attrition rate (%), estimated via LinkedIn tenure distribution or review mentions
indicators.rationale: Low turnover signals a stable operating base able to sustain a structured pilot through to completion.
indicators.comment: Very low turnover can also mean entrenched routines — cross-reference against Kununu/Glassdoor sentiment before scoring, since low turnover with poor reviews likely means people are staying out of necessity.
indicators.source_description: LinkedIn tenure distribution, Kununu/Glassdoor reviews, Bundesagentur für Arbeit regional turnover statistics
indicators.status_note: LinkedIn headcount history (reseller) or Kununu/Glassdoor tenure signals

indicators.label: Average Salary
indicators.proxy: Average personnel cost per employee, k EUR (Personalaufwand ÷ headcount)
indicators.rationale: Above-average pay suggests the company can attract and retain more skilled staff — a proxy for the internal capacity needed to run and absorb a pilot's findings.
indicators.comment: Benchmark against sector-average personnel cost per employee rather than an absolute threshold.
indicators.source_description: Bundesanzeiger annual filings (Personalaufwand line), Kununu/Glassdoor salary estimates
indicators.status_note: labour cost / 'Dipendenti' - both in the FINANCIAL_PL export (100%)

indicators.label: Skilled Labour Share
indicators.proxy: Share of roles requiring a technical/university qualification
indicators.rationale: A more technically skilled workforce lowers the onboarding cost of a new tool or process, directly reducing pilot execution risk.
indicators.comment: Overlaps with Average Salary; the two together are a stronger signal than either alone.
indicators.source_description: Job postings (Stepstone, Indeed), LinkedIn employee skill/role data
indicators.status_note: job-postings crawler

indicators.label: Job Posting Velocity (General)
indicators.proxy: Number of active job listings across all roles
indicators.rationale: General hiring velocity is a growth/capacity-pressure signal, distinct from Digital/Technical Job Postings above which is specifically about absorptive readiness.
indicators.comment: From the original sourcing plan; kept separate from digital_job_postings since one is a NEED/growth signal and the other a READINESS signal.
indicators.source_description: Arbeitsagentur Jobsuche API
indicators.status_note: job-postings crawler's own junk-filtered total-roles count (2026-09-22) - already computed for digital_job_postings' summary, just never written as its own signal. No Germany dependency, works for Italy

indicators.label: Employer Review Sentiment (Kununu/Glassdoor)
indicators.proxy: Average rating and recent review themes on Kununu or Glassdoor
indicators.rationale: Persistently poor internal culture reviews can undermine execution even when leadership is genuinely open, since a pilot ultimately depends on staff engagement to succeed.
indicators.comment: Use as a downgrade flag rather than a standalone positive/negative score.
indicators.source_description: Kununu, Glassdoor
indicators.status_note: Kununu direct scrape off by policy; reseller not bought

indicators.label: ESG / Sustainability Reporting
indicators.proxy: Years since the first sustainability/ESG report was published
indicators.rationale: Voluntarily adopting a new disclosure framework before it's mandatory signals broader institutional openness to adopting new frameworks in general.
indicators.comment: CSRD is making this mandatory for a growing share of Mittelstand companies, so this will become a weaker differentiator over the next few years — revisit periodically.
indicators.source_description: Company website, Bundesanzeiger (where CSRD-mandated), press releases
indicators.status_note: company-website crawler (LLM, token-bound)

indicators.label: Energy Transition / Sustainability CapEx
indicators.proxy: Disclosed spend on renewable energy, efficiency retrofits, or transition projects (% revenue)
indicators.rationale: Already committing capital to a transformation project is concrete evidence of present-tense change appetite, complementing the Energy Costs NEED signal.
indicators.comment: Pair with Energy Costs: high cost pressure plus active transition investment is a strong combined signal.
indicators.source_description: Bundesanzeiger annual filings, press releases, Fördermitteldatenbank energy transition grants
indicators.status_note: not in statements. Signals: sustainability report (website crawler), GSE/Transizione 4.0-5.0 incentives, press. Weak; consider first-contact

indicators.label: Number of Employees
indicators.proxy: Headcount, from Handelsregister/company register filings or LinkedIn company page
indicators.rationale: A segment-fit filter rather than a need/openness signal — operationalizes the Midcap-vs-SME distinction. Not scored on the need/readiness scale.
indicators.comment: Anchors the Midcap/SME segment cutoff used elsewhere in the tool; set explicit bounds once Stage 1 pilot data shows what actually worked.
indicators.source_description: Handelsregister, company website, LinkedIn company page, Bundesanzeiger filings
indicators.status_note: AIDA raw employees_latest / Company.headcount (100%) - a segment filter, not scored

indicators.label: Type of Product
indicators.proxy: Product category classification (physical good, service, hybrid, B2B component, B2C finished good)
indicators.rationale: A segmentation filter for matching pilot type to product type, not a need or readiness score.
indicators.comment: Scoring this high/low the way the rest of the table does would not be meaningful — kept as a classification tag.
indicators.source_description: Company website, product catalog
indicators.status_note: website LLM classification of the home page (context, not scored - lowest priority)

indicators.label: Family Ownership Share
indicators.proxy: % of equity held by the founding family
indicators.rationale: Doesn't predict openness either way on its own — its effect depends entirely on where the company sits on New Generation of Management (mid-succession is a strong readiness signal, an entrenched second generation is often the opposite).
indicators.comment: Always read jointly with the succession row rather than scoring independently.
indicators.source_description: Handelsregister shareholder register, Bundesanzeiger
indicators.status_note: same shareholder rows: shareholders sharing the officers' surname, by '% Totale' (context, not scored)

indicators.label: Recent M&A Activity
indicators.proxy: M&A announcements (acquirer or acquired) in the past 2 years
indicators.rationale: Cuts both ways: recent M&A can mean active, well-capitalized growth-seeking, or a company mid-integration and too distracted for a new pilot.
indicators.comment: Flag rather than score until clarified at first contact — don't read directionally without checking which case applies.
indicators.source_description: Press releases, Handelsregister ownership change filings
indicators.status_note: Google News RSS (context, not scored)

indicators.label: Leadership Page Transparency (proxy)
indicators.proxy: Leadership-title keyword mentions on the company's own About/Team page
indicators.rationale: A crude transparency proxy, not a measurement of demographic diversity — kept as context rather than folded into the Leadership & Succession scores above, which are the real diversity signals once automated.
indicators.comment: Real automation of Management National/Cultural/Gender Diversity above (rows 3-6) is future work; this existing adapter measures something different and shouldn't be conflated with them.
indicators.source_description: Company own-site About/Team page scrape
indicators.status_note: own-site 'team' page scrape

indicators.label: Partnership / Collaboration News Signals
indicators.proxy: Count of recent news results for partnership/collaboration/cooperation/pilot mentions
indicators.rationale: External engagement signal distinct from Press Mentions of New Launches — this searches specifically for partnership/collaboration language, closer to External Openness than to product-launch stagnation.
indicators.comment: From the original sourcing plan; kept in External Openness Track Record rather than remapped onto the new spreadsheet's launch-mentions row, since the two adapters search for different things.
indicators.source_description: Google Programmable Search API
indicators.status_note: Google News RSS

indicators.label: Difficulty of Logistics
indicators.proxy: Number of distribution intermediaries or handling steps between production and end customer
indicators.rationale: Complex, multi-step logistics is a concrete operational pain point that logistics-tech or route-optimization pilots can directly address.
indicators.comment: Mostly relevant to companies with physical distribution; treat as not applicable for pure services or software.
indicators.source_description: Annual report supply chain notes, first-contact interview, trade press on sector logistics norms
indicators.status_note: first-contact questionnaire

indicators.label: Customer Concentration
indicators.proxy: Estimated % of revenue from the top 3 clients
indicators.rationale: High dependency on a small number of customers is a structural revenue-risk pressure point — losing one client is existential, creating urgency for diversification or resilience-focused innovation.
indicators.comment: Rarely disclosed precisely by private Mittelstand companies; often only confirmable at first contact. Cross-reference with sector norms — some B2B/OEM-supplier models normally run concentrated.
indicators.source_description: Annual report risk disclosures, first-contact interview, trade press on major client relationships
indicators.status_note: first-contact questionnaire (weight 3); not in AIDA

indicators.label: Supplier Concentration
indicators.proxy: Number of alternative suppliers available for critical inputs
indicators.rationale: Single-source or low-diversity supplier dependency is a concrete operational vulnerability that sourcing-diversification or supply-chain-tech pilots can directly target.
indicators.comment: Overlaps with Rarity of Raw Materials, but distinct: that row is about scarcity of the input itself, this is about the company's own sourcing strategy and could apply even to a non-scarce input.
indicators.source_description: Annual report risk disclosures, first-contact interview, procurement trade press
indicators.status_note: first-contact questionnaire

indicators.label: Regulatory / Compliance Exposure
indicators.proxy: Count of upcoming mandatory regimes the company falls under by size/sector threshold (CSRD, CBAM, EU AI Act, supply-chain due-diligence laws)
indicators.rationale: An imminent mandatory compliance deadline is an externally forced NEED signal with a hard timeline — often the single most reliable trigger for budget approval since it removes the 'is this worth funding' debate.
indicators.comment: Very high-confidence signal in principle (thresholds are public, dates are fixed) — but EU scope thresholds move (e.g. the 2025 Omnibus CSRD simplification), so no threshold table is hardcoded here yet. No adapter built this pass: cataloged as T1/Phase 1 for when a maintained threshold table is wired in, not scored from a guessed rule today. Record manually via Company Intelligence in the meantime.
indicators.source_description: EU/national regulatory threshold tables (CSRD scope criteria, CBAM sector list, EU AI Act), company size/sector cross-reference
indicators.status_note: a curated, dated lookup table from EUR-Lex (NIS2, Machinery Regulation, Cyber Resilience Act, AI Act, CBAM) keyed by NACE and size. For this cohort (all NACE C28, 50-99 staff) the sector/size part is nearly constant - only the company-specific part discriminates. Deliberately not scraped: thresholds move

indicators.label: Insurance / Claims Cost Trend
indicators.proxy: Trend in insurance or self-reported claims cost (% change)
indicators.rationale: Rising insurance or claims costs, especially in logistics, manufacturing, or fleet-heavy sectors, often signal an unaddressed operational risk that risk-analytics or safety-tech pilots could reduce.
indicators.comment: The source spreadsheet's own note flags this as 'likely first-contact only in practice' despite listing a T1-style source — downgraded to T3/manual here rather than cataloged as an automatable tier that doesn't actually hold at Mittelstand filing detail.
indicators.source_description: Bundesanzeiger notes where disclosed, first-contact interview, sector claims benchmark reports
indicators.status_note: first-contact questionnaire

indicators.label: Competitor Digital Adoption Gap
indicators.proxy: Point gap between this company's Digital Maturity/Online Presence scores and 2-3 named direct competitors' same scores
indicators.rationale: A company falling visibly behind named competitors on digital adoption faces direct competitive pressure — a sharper, more specific NEED signal than an absolute digital-maturity score alone.
indicators.comment: Explicitly a derived variable, not a new independent data source: re-runs Digital Maturity of Core Website and Online Market Presence against named competitors. No adapter built yet — needs a competitor-tracking data model extension first (which companies are whose competitors isn't captured anywhere today); record manually via Company Intelligence until then.
indicators.source_description: Derived from Digital Maturity of Core Website and Online Market Presence rows, applied to named competitors
indicators.status_note: computed: a company's digital maturity vs its sector peers - needs website_digital_maturity filled first

indicators.label: Board/Management Public Statements on Innovation
indicators.proxy: Count of specific (non-boilerplate) innovation/digital-transformation statements in press or annual-report management commentary, trailing 12 months
indicators.rationale: Explicit, specific public statements of intent are a stated-intent signal — weaker than revealed-preference signals like External Collaboration, but easy to source and a useful early filter.
indicators.comment: Distinguish genuine specificity ('we are piloting X technology in Y plant') from generic boilerplate ('we value innovation'); the adapter's keyword search is a first pass; only the former should really count, so treat this as directional, not exact.
indicators.source_description: Annual report management commentary (Lagebericht), press interviews, LinkedIn posts by executives
indicators.status_note: Google News RSS

indicators.label: Vendor/Software Contract Renewal Timing
indicators.proxy: Estimated renewal window for core ERP/PM/CRM vendor contracts
indicators.rationale: A pilot proposal timed near an existing vendor contract's renewal window has a materially higher chance of becoming a real budget conversation than one proposed mid-contract.
indicators.comment: Timing variable, not a need or readiness signal on its own — use it to prioritize outreach sequencing among an otherwise similarly-scored shortlist, not to score companies independently. Kept at weight 0 / context for that reason, despite the source spreadsheet listing weight 3.
indicators.source_description: Job postings mentioning current systems, procurement/tender notices, first-contact interview
indicators.status_note: first-contact questionnaire (sequencing input)

indicators.label: Sector-Wide Innovation Pilot Precedent
indicators.proxy: Number of publicly documented startup pilots or open-innovation programs already run by other companies in the same sector and size band
indicators.rationale: A sector with visible precedent lowers the perceived risk of being 'the first' for any individual target company — a market-level moderator, not a company-specific one.
indicators.comment: Sector-level, not company-level — use it to sequence which of the priority sectors to approach first, not to score individual companies. Kept at weight 0 / context for that reason, despite the source spreadsheet listing weight 2.
indicators.source_description: Press releases, accelerator/corporate-venturing case study pages, trade press
indicators.status_note: news-signals-crawler needs NEWSAPI_KEY (paid). Free route: extend the RSS adapter

indicators.label: EBITDA Trend
indicators.proxy: EBITDA % change, latest fiscal year vs the earliest of the last three (same method as EBIT Trend)
indicators.rationale: Cash-earnings view of the same operating trend EBIT Trend scores; shown for context, not double-counted.
indicators.comment: Informational only. Values used to be the latest EBITDA level in k EUR under this 'trend' name; recomputed as a real % change. A near-zero or negative base year makes the % meaningless.
indicators.source_description: AIDA / Bundesanzeiger annual filings
indicators.status_note: AIDA import (EBITDA x3 years; context, not scored)

indicators.label: EBIT Margin
indicators.proxy: EBIT ÷ revenue, latest fiscal year (%)
indicators.rationale: The LEVEL of operating profitability. EBIT Trend says whether it is moving; a company can be shrinking from a fat margin or stable on a razor-thin one.
indicators.comment: Read by the Eroding profitability pain point. Real portfolio: median 5.9%, 10th percentile -3.6%.
indicators.source_description: AIDA: RISULTATO OPERATIVO ÷ Ricavi vendite e prestazioni
indicators.status_note: not in GAP_PLAN yet - add it there

indicators.label: Net Margin
indicators.proxy: Net income ÷ revenue, latest fiscal year (%)
indicators.rationale: What is left after financing, tax and one-offs — the gap to EBIT margin shows how much the balance sheet costs.
indicators.comment: Informational. Real portfolio: median 3.7%, 10th percentile -3.5%.
indicators.source_description: AIDA: Utile Netto ÷ Ricavi vendite e prestazioni
indicators.status_note: not in GAP_PLAN yet - add it there

indicators.label: Cash Cover (months of revenue)
indicators.proxy: Cash ÷ (revenue ÷ 12): how many months of sales the company holds in cash
indicators.rationale: Cash Position is an absolute amount and means nothing without size. Cash cover is the size-relative liquidity cushion.
indicators.comment: Read by the Thin cash cushion pain point. Real portfolio: median 1.4 months, 25th percentile 0.5, 10th 0.1.
indicators.source_description: AIDA: TOT. DISPON. LIQUIDE ÷ (Ricavi ÷ 12)
indicators.status_note: not in GAP_PLAN yet - add it there

indicators.label: Intangible Assets Share
indicators.proxy: Intangible fixed assets as % of total assets
indicators.rationale: A rough proxy for capitalised know-how, software and development spend that is not visible in a patent count.
indicators.comment: Informational. Real portfolio: median 1.2%, 90th percentile 10.7% — most machinery makers carry almost none.
indicators.source_description: AIDA: TOTALE IMMOB. IMMATERIALI ÷ TOTALE ATTIVO
indicators.status_note: not in GAP_PLAN yet - add it there

indicators.label: Revenue per Employee
indicators.proxy: Revenue ÷ employees, latest fiscal year (k EUR)
indicators.rationale: A productivity read: low revenue per head in a sector of peers points at manual, labour-heavy operations.
indicators.comment: Informational; compare within the sector, not across sectors. Real portfolio: median 258 k EUR.
indicators.source_description: AIDA: Ricavi vendite e prestazioni ÷ Dipendenti
indicators.status_note: not in GAP_PLAN yet - add it there

indicators.label: Headcount Growth
indicators.proxy: Headcount % change, latest fiscal year vs the earliest of the last three
indicators.rationale: Hiring against flat revenue, or shrinking headcount on rising revenue, both say something the revenue trend alone does not.
indicators.comment: Informational. Real portfolio: median +3.7%, 5th percentile -16%, 95th +45%.
indicators.source_description: AIDA: Dipendenti (three years)
indicators.status_note: not in GAP_PLAN yet - add it there

indicators.label: Formal Distress Procedure on Record
indicators.proxy: 1 when the company registry shows an insolvency, composition-with-creditors, protective-measures or liquidation procedure with no recorded closing date; 0 otherwise
indicators.rationale: A court-supervised procedure is the strongest distress evidence there is, and usually means no discretionary pilot budget.
indicators.comment: Read by the Insolvency / restructuring procedure pain point. Relocations and mergers, which fill the same registry column, are not counted. 'Open' is inferred from a missing closing date, so read the text before acting on it.
indicators.source_description: AIDA: Procedura/Cessazione with its start and closing dates
indicators.status_note: not in GAP_PLAN yet - add it there

indicators.label: Year of Latest Filed Accounts
indicators.proxy: Calendar year in which the company's latest available accounts closed
indicators.rationale: Every financial figure is 'as of' this date. It is FY2025 for most of the portfolio, FY2024 for a third, and years old for a handful — those figures describe a company that may no longer exist in that shape.
indicators.comment: Informational. A company whose latest accounts are 2+ years old should not be scored as if its numbers were current.
indicators.source_description: AIDA: Data di chiusura ultimo bilancio
indicators.status_note: not in GAP_PLAN yet - add it there

indicators.label: BvD Independence Indicator
indicators.proxy: Bureau van Dijk's ownership-independence class, as an ordinal: 1 = A (most independent), 2 = B, 3 = C, 4 = D (least independent)
indicators.rationale: Whether a company decides for itself or answers to a parent — the difference between a 2-week and a 6-month approval chain.
indicators.comment: Informational. About two thirds of the real portfolio is class D. Read with Group Size: a D-class company in a group of 300 is a subsidiary, not an owner-managed Mittelstand firm.
indicators.source_description: AIDA: Indicatore d'Indipendenza BvD
indicators.status_note: not in GAP_PLAN yet - add it there

indicators.label: Corporate Group Size
indicators.proxy: Number of companies in the corporate group the company belongs to (1 = standalone)
indicators.rationale: A large group means decisions, budgets and vendor choices are made above the company you are talking to.
indicators.comment: Informational. Real portfolio: median 4, but a quarter belong to groups of 13+ and the top decile to groups of 100+.
indicators.source_description: AIDA: N. di società nel gruppo societario
indicators.status_note: not in GAP_PLAN yet - add it there

indicators.label: Foreign Ownership Share
indicators.proxy: % of equity held by non-Italian shareholders, from the disclosed shareholder list
